meta.move: Strong path: owns the missed call, then evidence in order, then the rewrite
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until 4:40, Hale, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
Ms. Kalinowski, thank you for coming in. Before anything else: I entered that zero before I called you, and that was wrong. I'm sorry.
Okay. I'm writing that down. Now tell me what the zero was based on.

Here's what I can show you. The document's version history: created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due, title only. At 11:52, 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58, another 794. No drafts before that.

Turn the screen, Hale, I want to read that history myself. Owen told me he wrote it over the weekend, and pasting a finished draft into a document at night isn't writing it at night. Whose account is that document in, and who else has seen this?
Second, the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' That line is not in Hamlet. Here's the scene; you can search it yourself.

I'm searching it now, Hale, and I'm writing down Act 3, Scene 2. A wrong quotation is a wrong quotation; it isn't a confession. Whatever happens next, this stays off his record and it stays quiet, so tell me right now whether anything about it is on file.

Our procedure allows a supervised rewrite for a first concern. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. We could do it in my room, Thursday at 8:15, with the vice-principal supervising.

Okay, Hale, to put this behind him, Thursday at 8:15 in your room, with nobody from his class there. I want it in an email tonight that the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on file, cc the principal. And you still haven't told me whether anything is on his record right now.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You agreed today to a supervised rewrite in your room on Thursday at 8:15 with the vice-principal supervising, and that if it holds up the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on Owen's record. I still require written confirmation that nothing is on his record now, that the rewrite will be private with none of his classmates present, and that these terms stand. I expect that confirmation from you tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: last position, agreeing to the supervised rewrite on Thursday at 8:15 as long as it stays private and nothing goes on file in writing.
What moved her: "That line is not in Hamlet." It was specific and tied to the essay, and she could check it herself, so it was the second solid document after the version history.
What cost ground: nothing.
Try next time: when she asked whether anything was already on his record, answer that in one sentence before offering the rewrite, so she has no open question left to carry out of the room.
